reuse.why: Uses the existing refuseIfAlreadyLinked wrapper, findOrCreateBank, syncAccount and handleSyncResponse, and routes Fintegra through newly shared saveLinkedAccount/linkProviderAccount/downloadProviderTransactions that the existing providers also use.

duplication.why: Instead of adding another copy of the link and download flows it collapses the existing copies (Pluggy.ai, Akahu, GoCardless, SimpleFin, Enable Banking) into shared helpers; Fintegra adds only thin wrappers.

placement.why: Shared link logic stays in accounts/app.ts, download logic in accounts/sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts and types in types/models, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: The feature is bundled with a sizeable refactor of GoCardless, SimpleFin and Enable Banking link handlers that Fintegra does not need, enlarging the diff and review surface.

maintainability.why: Provider differences (bank key, fileId, notified tables) become explicit parameters and future providers are a few lines, though GoCardless/SimpleFin/EnableBanking still keep their own sync/notify tails and saveLinkedAccount takes a loose `source: string`.

bypasses_abstraction.where: fintegra-accounts-link is registered through refuseIfAlreadyLinked like the other providers.

disguised_duplication.where: Existing duplication is removed into shared functions rather than reshaped.
